description: This file controls how the game groups levels together. This is mainly used for condensing level names in desecrated (terror) zone messaging
source: Colonnes du .txt (BKVince 3.2) ; types/descriptions du guide TXT eezstreet-d2rdoc.

columns.name: LevelGroupId
columns.description: Defines the unique name pointer for the level group, which is used in other files

columns.name: ParentLevelGroupId
columns.description: Defines a parent for this level group. If the parent group is completed then this level group will not be displayed.

columns.name: CompleteThreshold
columns.description: Percent amount of the level group to satisfy before it is marked as completed.

columns.name: Effect
columns.description: Controls what effect to play for this level group when it is completed.

columns.name: NameString
columns.description: String Field. Used for displaying the name of the level group, such as when all levels in a group have been desecrated.
